recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, grainy portrait of a male singer with dark hair and a mustache, captured mid-performance in a recording studio. The lighting is warm on the face against a cool, blue-toned background, with a prominent microphone silhouette in the foreground and a thin border framing the image.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm skin tones contrasting against a cool blue studio background
Outlined typography positioned at the top edge, mirroring the horizontal frame
The dark silhouette of the microphone balancing the singer's head on the right
coreInvariants: Thin white or light yellow outline on all capital letters
Narrow black outer border framing the square composition

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The singer's head is centered horizontally, occupying most of the vertical space, slightly angled to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The singer's illuminated face acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the singer's expression to the microphone on the right, then upward to the text along the top edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark hair and clothing blend into the shadows, creating a sense of depth against the blue background.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blue and teal background tones
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm amber and peach skin tones
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale yellow or cream for the text outlines
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the bright face and the dark, moody studio environment.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are defined by a thin outline rather than a solid fill
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for both artist name and title, separated by a bullet point.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric skeleton and rounded terminals.
Provides the correct friendly, rounded geometric feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A grainy 1970s-style photograph of a man with dark hair and a mustache singing into a large studio microphone. Warm lighting on the face, cool blue studio background. Square format with a thin black border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of text at the top edge in all caps. Use a geometric sans-serif font with a thin light yellow outline and no fill. Use wide tracking and separate the two phrases with a bullet point.

verificationChecks: Is the image texture grainy like film?
Is the color palette a mix of warm face tones and cool blue background?
Is the composition square with a thin border?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist
Any brand logos on the microphone
Exact wording of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the grain is uniform across the image.
Check that the text outline is consistent in weight.
Verify the microphone silhouette is dark and distinct.
Confirm the square aspect ratio is maintained.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a grainy, warm-lit studio portrait with a cool-toned background and top-aligned, outlined geometric sans-serif typography for a classic 70s singer-songwriter aesthetic.
